leads.title: Belshazzar's feast and the writing on the wall ↔ The striking day: moths, wool and the scales
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: A person is weighed in the balances and found wanting (weight 6.0). Pair score 6.0.

Only in Belshazzar's feast and the writing on the wall: A king holds a great feast for a thousand nobles and drinks wine before them; Idols listed as gods of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood and stone that neither see nor hear nor know; Fingers of a human hand appear and write on the plaster of the palace wall opposite the lampstand; That very night the king is killed and his kingdom passes to another people; The king's face blanches, his hip-joints loosen and his knees knock together in terror; The sage is renowned for interpreting dreams, explaining riddles and 'loosing knots'; The writing 'Mene, mene, tekel, u-pharsin' is read as numbered, weighed and divided; The queen (mother) reminds the king of a forgotten sage who solved riddles in his father's day; Reward offered to the interpreter: purple robe, gold chain and rule as third in the kingdom; The king and his concubines drink from the vessels taken from God's temple while praising idols; The prophet tells the king to keep his gifts for himself; A king is driven from human society to live with beasts, eating grass like oxen, wet with dew, with hair like eagles' feathers and nails like birds' claws; and 4 more.

Only in The striking day: moths, wool and the scales: The one whose scales are light: 'his mother is Hawiya (the abyss)', a blazing fire; On the striking day (al-qari'a) people will be like scattered moths; On the day the mountains will be like (carded, dyed) wool ('ihn); Deeds are weighed on judgment day; heavy scales mean salvation, light scales loss; Spies seem like grasshoppers in their own eyes and the giants'; Hell given proper names: Laza (scalp-stripper), Saqar (scorcher, leaves nothing), al-Hutama (the crusher), Hawiya (the abyss); Rhetorical formula 'And what will make you know what X is?' (wa ma adraka ma) introducing an eschatological term.

matches.label: A person is weighed in the balances and found wanting
matches.note: fa-ammā man thaqulat mawāzīnuhu ... wa-ammā man khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ummuhu hāwiya ~ teqēl teqîltāh ve-môʾzanyāʾ we-hištekaḥat ḥassîr. Cognate vocabulary: Aramaic teqal / Arabic thaqula 'weigh/be heavy', môʾzanyāʾ / mawāzīn 'scales'. One king weighed in history in Daniel; every person's deeds weighed at the Judgment in the Quran.

Only in Comfort my people; a voice in the wilderness; to whom will you liken God: 'Comfort, comfort my people': Jerusalem's term of service is ended and she has received double for her sins; God tends his flock like a shepherd, gathers the lambs in his arm and carries them in his bosom; God brings out the starry host by number and calls each by name; none is missing; God sits enthroned above the circle (hug) of the earth; its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; Those who wait for YHWH renew strength, mount up with wings like eagles, run and not be weary; Nations are like a drop from a bucket and dust on the scales; Lebanon is not enough fuel nor its beasts enough for a burnt offering; A voice cries: 'In the wilderness clear the way of YHWH, make straight in the desert a highway for our God'; Who measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, marked off heaven with a span and weighed the mountains in scales?; God made everything grow in due weight and sends it down only in known measure; A double portion (k-p-l) from God [divergence between the texts]; On the Day of Resurrection the whole earth is in God's grip and the heavens folded in his right hand; A herald of good news (mevasseret Tsiyyon) goes up on a high mountain to announce 'Behold your God!'; and 18 more.
